annotations.title: Check an x402 seller before paying

description: Call this before any x402 payment, before retrying a request that answered HTTP 402, or whenever the user is about to buy an API call with USDC on Base or names an API they intend to pay per call. Returns a verdict (avoid, caution, ok, unknown), one sentence to act on, the seller's paid-call count and failure rate with a 95% interval, listed price, modal quote and max overcharge ratio when known, and links to the seller page and raw evidence.

url.description: x402 resource URL, or a bare seller domain such as api.example.com

name: check_x402_seller

candidate.description: Queue state for a seller not yet measured; null otherwise

probe.description: Hourly unpaid probes of the seller's 402 quote; null when not probed

resource.description: Measured paid calls to this exact URL; null when not measured

by_type.description: Failure counts by type (non_delivery, overcharge, duplicate, wrong_goods)

wilson_high.description: 95% interval upper bound on the failure rate

wilson_low.description: 95% interval lower bound on the failure rate

seller.description: Measured paid calls to this seller; null when the study never paid it

verdict_text.description: One sentence to act on, with the evidence link

title: Check an x402 seller before paying
